# Læsø

Læsø is a Danish municipality included in the clinical quality assessments of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the treatment of atrial fibrillation across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing Læsø as one of the local benchmarks for healthcare quality development and regional comparison [^src1]. 

Specifically, Læsø's data is featured in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulation (AC) treatment among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. This specific indicator relies on data from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. In the report's municipal breakdown, Læsø recorded 0 stroke events out of 83 relevant patients, reflecting a 0.0% event rate for this quality metric [^src1]. Because the data is thin and limited to this specific tabular mention, no further historical or relational details are available in the current corpus.
